title: OL-20261125-1: Scratch bootstrap tenants are not torn down
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** daily seed-launch.yml run
**Done check:** file:foundation/seedlaunch.py
**Status:** closed

seedlaunch --e2e-scratch leaves a Worker and D1 per day; site worker has no delete route. Add a scoped delete for bootproof-* names in site/deployer.js and call it after the probe. Also audit other repos and the Cloudflare account for hand-made resources.

**Vacuous:** 2026-11-25T20:52:23Z vacuous: the probe was never recorded failing on this item, so its pass cannot show the defect is gone; rewrite the probe so it fails while the defect exists

**Disposition:** fixed (ttl, 2026-11-26T02:54:39Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).

**Evidence:** 2026-11-26T03:02:37Z closing probe passed after the item was disposed: file:foundation/seedlaunch.py
